components:

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier following the codebase's existing conventions for derived snapshot fields (the same pattern used for `namesakeCount`).

**The rule:** `membershipTier` is `GOLD` when the owner's household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3+ members after the create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner.java`** — Added a persisted `householdSize` snapshot field (`household_size` column) with accessors, and made `getMembershipTier()` return `"GOLD"` first when `householdSize >= 3`, falling through to the unchanged SILVER/BRONZE logic otherwise.

2. **`HouseholdMemberCounter.java`** (new) — A small single-responsibility `@Component` mirroring `NamesakeCounter`. It counts household members (owners sharing the owner's `householdId`) including the owner itself, reusing the existing `findByLastNameIgnoreCase` lookup — valid because household members always share a last name (the `householdId` is derived from last name + address). An owner with no `householdId` is a household of one.

3. **`ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — Injected `HouseholdMemberCounter` and stamped `householdSize` in `saveOwner` for new owners, right alongside `customerCode` and `namesakeCount`. This runs after `joinHousehold` has assigned the shared `householdId` and back-filled existing members, so the count reflects the household "after this create".

4. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`) — Added the `household_size INTEGER` column where the sibling `namesake_count` column already lives (hsqldb drives the test DB; mysql/postgres don't track these derived columns, so I left them as the maintainers had them).

5. **`openapi.yml`** — Added `GOLD` to the `membershipTier` enum and updated its description, so the generated `OwnerDto` accepts the new value.

Walkthrough of the test's 3-member household: member 1 → size 1, member 2 → size 2, member 3 → 2 existing members + self = 3 → `GOLD`. ✅

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier following the codebase's existing conventions for derived snapshot fields (the same pattern used for `namesakeCount`).

**The rule:** `membershipTier` is `GOLD` when the owner's household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3+ members after the create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner.java`** — Added a persisted `householdSize` snapshot field (`household_size` column) with accessors, and made `getMembershipTier()` return `"GOLD"` first when `householdSize >= 3`, falling through to the unchanged SILVER/BRONZE logic otherwise.

2. **`HouseholdMemberCounter.java`** (new) — A small single-responsibility `@Component` mirroring `NamesakeCounter`. It counts household members (owners sharing the owner's `householdId`) including the owner itself, reusing the existing `findByLastNameIgnoreCase` lookup — valid because household members always share a last name (the `householdId` is derived from last name + address). An owner with no `householdId` is a household of one.

3. **`ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — Injected `HouseholdMemberCounter` and stamped `householdSize` in `saveOwner` for new owners, right alongside `customerCode` and `namesakeCount`. This runs after `joinHousehold` has assigned the shared `householdId` and back-filled existing members, so the count reflects the household "after this create".

4. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`) — Added the `household_size INTEGER` column where the sibling `namesake_count` column already lives (hsqldb drives the test DB; mysql/postgres don't track these derived columns, so I left them as the maintainers had them).

5. **`openapi.yml`** — Added `GOLD` to the `membershipTier` enum and updated its description, so the generated `OwnerDto` accepts the new value.

Walkthrough of the test's 3-member household: member 1 → size 1, member 2 → size 2, member 3 → 2 existing members + self = 3 → `GOLD`. ✅
